Release notes · v132 corrected · 17 Nov 2026 11:54 GST
  • v132 correction verification marker: Height-aware request-pack pagination, bottom-anchored issued-record footnotes, normal-mode outer scrolling and one focused-pane scroller rebuilt from the actual v132 baseline · 17 Nov 2026 11:54 GST.
  • v132 issued request-pack PDF: Rebuilt the Project Brief request-pack PDF as a static issued record aligned to the Power Apps response portal visual hierarchy. It now includes the ENGAGE header, request-pack reference, project and asset/group, addressee, issue and response dates, reference/status details and compact Project, Assets, Requested by, Respond by and Requirements cards.
  • Asset and Brief-section grouping: Requirements are ordered first by asset and then by Brief section. Every requirement shows Brief ID above the item title, the full question, Typical input, Complete by S1/S2, and fixed Response / requirement and Supporting reference instructions.
  • Static record boundary: Portal navigation, progress-entry indicators, editable fields, response-position choices, Save draft, Review responses and Submit responses are deliberately excluded from the PDF. The issued-record footer confirms that responses are submitted separately and remain subject to design-team review before controlled-brief incorporation.
  • Portal preserved: The local Power Apps response layout preview and its v130 Previous/Next navigation correction remain unchanged.
  • v130 and earlier functionality retained: Request-pack actions, focus modes, Scope toggle, Brief Issue navigation, manual CSV export/import, proposals, normal ENGAGE navigation and Save/Open/browser-reopen persistence remain in place.
Report previewPrint dialog: choose “Save as PDF”, turn off “Headers and footers”
